ns2:section.sectionText: 'Fast' numerical algorithms and related numerical methods, emphasizing applications to the fast solution of partial differential equations. Numerical rank, complexity/accuracy trade-offs, notions of convergence. Multi-level compression schemes. Tree codes, Fast Multipole Methods. Potential Theory and Integral Equations. Quadrature. Fast, compression-based, linear-time direct solvers based, randomized linear algebra. Fast function transforms: Uniform and non-uniform FFTs, Butterfly algorithms. Prerequisites: Linear Algebra, programming experience, some exposure to Partial Differential Equations.
